# Synopsis: *Jamestown*
### Book Two of The Shadow War Chronicles

**Author**: Raymond Bayly  
**Series**: *The Shadow War Chronicles* (Book 2 of 9)  
**Genre**: Military Sci-Fi / Space Opera  
**Length**: ~109,639 words · 27 Chapters + Epilogue  
**Formats Available**: DOCX, Markdown, KPF  

---

## Part I: Retail Back Cover Blurb

> **“I am busy being sociable to the fucking gargoyle clan, so this had better be good,”** Captain Blake Campbell whispered into his comm, casually sipping bottom-shelf alien liquor while eyeballing seven predatory giants across a cantina table.
> 
> *“Hey, Cap. Shit is about to get real down there,”* came the reply. *“Mothership just scrambled gunships. They’re locking on your position.”*
> 
> Blake pulled a small black detonator from his flight jacket and smiled at the monsters. 
> 
> **“You know, I have this crazy-ass Russian on my ship. When I hit this button, something really cool is going to happen. You guys want to see?”**

***

extra.section_header: The Shadows have stepped into the light. And humanity is their next target.
